figurative_meaning_en: to be spent or to incur expense
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাড়ি সাজানোর জন্য প্রচুর অর্থ খসল।
example_sentences_in_english: A lot of money was spent on this trip.
Huge expenses were incurred in renovating the house.
note: Often used in the context of money, as in 'টাকা খসা' implying expenditure.
